```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)

projects      <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "new_projects.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
schools       <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
recommended   <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "recommended_projects.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Date range defaults: current school year (Aug 1 - Jul 31)
school_year_start <- if (as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m")) >= 8) {
  paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "-08-01")
} else {
  paste0(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - 1, "-08-01")
}
date_min <- school_year_start
date_max <- as.character(Sys.Date())

# Known EPI school names (canonical list)
known_schools <- schools$school_name

# Build a simplified project list for client-side rendering
proj_list <- projects |>
  mutate(
    project_date = as.character(project_date),
    is_new_school = !(school_name %in% known_schools),
    # Partnership info
    has_partner = case_when(
      `9` == "Yes" & !is.na(`9_2_TEXT`) & !`9_2_TEXT` %in% c("No", "NA", "") ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    partner_name = if_else(has_partner, `9_2_TEXT`, NA_character_),
    # Notes (Q67) - exclude "No" and empty
    notes = if_else(
      !is.na(`67`) & !`67` %in% c("No", "No.", "NA", "N/A", ""),
      `67`, NA_character_
    ),
    # Build project-type-specific summary
    summary = case_when(
      # MGR Installation
      str_detect(project_type, "MGR") ~ paste0(
        if_else(!is.na(`12_1`), paste0(`12_1`, " lanterns distributed"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`13`), paste0(", ", `13`, " lantern groups"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`14`), paste0(" (~", `14`, " students/group)"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`10`) & `10` == "Yes" & !is.na(`11`),
          paste0(". MGR moved from ", `11`), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`17_1`), paste0(". ", `17_1`, " computers given"), "")
      ),
      # Solar
      str_detect(project_type, "Solar") ~ paste0(
        if_else(!is.na(`28`), paste0(`28`, " solar panels installed"), "Solar panels installed"),
        if_else(!is.na(`12_1`), paste0(", ", `12_1`, " lanterns"), "")
      ),
      # Starlink
      project_type == "Starlink" ~ paste0(
        "Starlink installed",
        if_else(!is.na(`21`) & `21` == "Yes", " in EPI computer lab", ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`22`) & str_detect(`22`, "removed"), ". RACHEL device replaced", "")
      ),
      # Building Construction
      str_detect(project_type, "Building") ~ paste0(
        if_else(!is.na(`29`), `29`, "Building"),
        if_else(!is.na(`30`), paste0(" (", `30`, " rooms)"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`33_1`) & `33_1` != "0", paste0(". ", `33_1`, " science kits given"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`36`) & `36` != "0", paste0(". Menstrual kits distributed"), "")
      ),
      # GROW Project
      project_type == "GROW Project" ~ paste0(
        "GROW Project",
        if_else(!is.na(`47`) & str_detect(`47`, "Yes"), " with library books from EPI", ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`50`) & !`50` %in% c("Nothing", "", "NA", "Other:"),
          paste0(". Also distributed: ", str_remove(`50`, ",?\\s*Other:?\\s*")), "")
      ),
      # Fallback
      TRUE ~ project_type
    )
  ) |>
  # Clean up leading/trailing commas and spaces in summary
  mutate(summary = str_remove(summary, "^,\\s*") |> str_remove(",\\s*$") |> str_squish()) |>
  select(project_date, project_type, school_name, is_new_school, visitor,
         has_partner, partner_name, summary, notes) |>
  arrange(desc(project_date))

proj_json <- toJSON(proj_list, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
n_projects <- nrow(proj_list)

# Recommended projects: keep most recent per school, exclude "No" responses
rec_list <- recommended |>
  mutate(update_date = as.character(update_date)) |>
  # Drop "No" responses (including "No, they do not need anything..." variants)
  filter(!is.na(recommend_project) & recommend_project != "") |>
  filter(recommend_project != "No") |>
  filter(!str_detect(recommend_project, "^No,")) |>
  filter(!str_detect(recommend_project, "^No\\s")) |>
  group_by(school_name) |>
  slice_max(update_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(school_name, update_date, recommend_project, recommended_types,
         recommend_mgr_swap, visitor) |>
  arrange(school_name)

rec_json <- toJSON(rec_list, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

htmltools::HTML(paste0(
'<!-- Tab Navigation -->
<div id="project-tabs" style="display:flex; gap:0; margin-bottom:0; border-bottom:2px solid #e9ecef;">
  <button class="proj-tab active" data-tab="completed" style="flex:1; padding:0.75rem 1rem; border:none; background:none; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:600; color:#999; cursor:pointer; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; margin-bottom:-2px; transition:all 0.15s;">
    Completed Projects
  </button>
  <button class="proj-tab" data-tab="recommended" style="flex:1; padding:0.75rem 1rem; border:none; background:none; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:600; color:#999; cursor:pointer; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; margin-bottom:-2px; transition:all 0.15s;">
    Recommended Projects <span id="tab-count-rec" style="background:#28a745; color:#fff; border-radius:10px; padding:0.1rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.75rem; margin-left:0.35rem;"></span>
  </button>
</div>

<!-- Tab: Completed Projects -->
<div id="tab-completed" class="proj-tab-content" style="padding-top:1rem;">

<!-- Filters -->
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.75rem; align-items:center; margin-bottom:1.5rem; justify-content:center;">
  <label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy);">Date Range:</label>
  <input type="date" id="date-start" value="', date_min, '" style="padding:0.35rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px;">
  <span>to</span>
  <input type="date" id="date-end" value="', date_max, '" style="padding:0.35rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px;">
  <select id="type-filter" style="padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; max-width:220px;">
    <option value="">All Project Types</option>
  </select>
  <button id="btn-apply-dates" style="background:var(--epi-navy); color:#fff; border:none; padding:0.4rem 1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">Apply</button>
  <button id="btn-reset-dates" style="background:#e9ecef; color:#333; border:none; padding:0.4rem 1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;">Reset</button>
</div>

<!-- Project Cards Container -->
<div id="projects-container"></div>
</div>

<!-- Tab: Recommended Projects -->
<div id="tab-recommended" class="proj-tab-content" style="display:none; padding-top:1rem;">
  <h3 style="color:var(--epi-navy); margin-top:0; margin-bottom:1rem;">Schools recommended to be reviewed for new projects.</h3>
  <div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.75rem; align-items:center; margin-bottom:1.5rem; justify-content:center;">
    <label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy);">Date Range:</label>
    <input type="date" id="rec-date-start" value="', date_min, '" style="padding:0.35rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px;">
    <span>to</span>
    <input type="date" id="rec-date-end" value="', date_max, '" style="padding:0.35rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px;">
    <select id="rec-filter" style="padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; max-width:220px;">
      <option value="">All Recommendations</option>
      <option value="Yes">Recommended</option>
      <option value="Maybe">Maybe</option>
      <option value="mgr-swap">MGR Swap Recommended</option>
    </select>
    <button id="btn-apply-rec" style="background:var(--epi-navy); color:#fff; border:none; padding:0.4rem 1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">Apply</button>
    <button id="btn-reset-rec" style="background:#e9ecef; color:#333; border:none; padding:0.4rem 1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;">Reset</button>
  </div>
  <div id="recommended-container"></div>
</div>

<script>
var ALL_PROJECTS = ', proj_json, ';
var ALL_RECOMMENDED = ', rec_json, ';

// Color mapping for project types
var TYPE_COLORS = {
  "Electricity Generating MGR Installation": {bg: "#fff3cd", border: "#ffc107", label: "MGR Installation"},
  "Solar Project for Lanterns Specifically (No MGR)": {bg: "#d1ecf1", border: "#17a2b8", label: "Solar (Lanterns)"},
  "Solar Project (not for lanterns)": {bg: "#d1ecf1", border: "#17a2b8", label: "Solar"},
  "Starlink": {bg: "#e2e3f1", border: "#6f42c1", label: "Starlink"},
  "Building Construction": {bg: "#f5d6cc", border: "#dc3545", label: "Building Construction"},
  "GROW Project": {bg: "#d4edda", border: "#28a745", label: "GROW Project"},
  "Science Kit Distribution": {bg: "#fde8d0", border: "#fd7e14", label: "Science Kits"},
  "Menstrual Kit Distribution": {bg: "#f8d7da", border: "#e83e8c", label: "Menstrual Kits"}
};

function getTypeInfo(projectType) {
  // Check for exact match first
  if (TYPE_COLORS[projectType]) return TYPE_COLORS[projectType];
  // Check for partial matches (for combined types like "Building,Science,Menstrual")
  for (var key in TYPE_COLORS) {
    if (projectType.indexOf(key) >= 0) return TYPE_COLORS[key];
  }
  return {bg: "#e9ecef", border: "#6c757d", label: projectType};
}

function makeProjectCard(p) {
  var typeInfo = getTypeInfo(p.project_type);
  var types = p.project_type.split(",");

  var badgesHtml = "";
  types.forEach(function(t) {
    var info = getTypeInfo(t.trim());
    badgesHtml += \'<span style="display:inline-block; background:\' + info.bg + \'; color:#333; border:1px solid \' + info.border + \'; padding:0.15rem 0.6rem; border-radius:12px; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; margin-right:0.35rem; margin-bottom:0.25rem;">\' + info.label + \'</span>\';
  });

  var html = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.25rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1rem; border-left:4px solid \' + typeInfo.border + \';">\';

  // Header row: school name + date
  html += \'<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.5rem;">\';
  html += \'<div>\';
  var slug = p.school_name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/-$/, "");
  html += \'<a href="schools.html?school=\' + slug + \'" style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-weight:700; font-size:1.05rem; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--epi-navy);">\' + p.school_name + \'</a>\';
  if (p.is_new_school) {
    html += \' <span style="background:#dc3545; color:#fff; padding:0.1rem 0.5rem; border-radius:10px; font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:600;">NEW SCHOOL</span>\';
  }
  html += \'</div>\';
  var dateStr = p.project_date || "";
  if (dateStr) {
    var d = new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00");
    dateStr = d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric"});
  }
  html += \'<span style="color:#999; font-size:0.8rem; white-space:nowrap;">\' + dateStr + \'</span>\';
  html += \'</div>\';

  // Type badges
  html += \'<div style="margin-bottom:0.5rem;">\' + badgesHtml + \'</div>\';

  // Partner
  if (p.has_partner && p.partner_name) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.85rem; margin:0.25rem 0; color:#555;"><strong>Partner:</strong> \' + p.partner_name + \'</p>\';
  }

  // Summary
  if (p.summary && p.summary !== p.project_type) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0.4rem 0 0; color:#333;">\' + p.summary + \'</p>\';
  }

  // Notes
  if (p.notes) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.85rem; margin:0.4rem 0 0; color:#666; font-style:italic;">Notes: \' + p.notes + \'</p>\';
  }

  // Visitor
  if (p.visitor) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.8rem; margin:0.35rem 0 0; color:#aaa;">Recorded by \' + p.visitor + \'</p>\';
  }

  html += \'</div>\';
  return html;
}

// Populate project type dropdown from data
function populateTypeFilter() {
  var select = document.getElementById("type-filter");
  var currentVal = select.value;
  var types = {};
  ALL_PROJECTS.forEach(function(p) {
    if (p.project_type) {
      // Split combined types (e.g. "Building Construction,Science Kit Distribution")
      p.project_type.split(",").forEach(function(t) {
        var trimmed = t.trim();
        var info = getTypeInfo(trimmed);
        types[trimmed] = info.label;
      });
    }
  });
  select.innerHTML = \'<option value="">All Project Types</option>\';
  Object.keys(types).sort().forEach(function(key) {
    var opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = key;
    opt.textContent = types[key];
    select.appendChild(opt);
  });
  select.value = currentVal;
}

function renderProjects() {
  var startDate = document.getElementById("date-start").value;
  var endDate = document.getElementById("date-end").value;
  var typeFilter = document.getElementById("type-filter").value;

  var filtered = ALL_PROJECTS.filter(function(p) {
    if (!p.project_date) return true;
    if (startDate && p.project_date < startDate) return false;
    if (endDate && p.project_date > endDate) return false;
    if (typeFilter && (!p.project_type || p.project_type.indexOf(typeFilter) < 0)) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // Render cards
  var container = document.getElementById("projects-container");
  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#999; font-style:italic; margin:0;">No projects found in this date range.</p></div>\';
    return;
  }

  var html = "";
  filtered.forEach(function(p) {
    html += makeProjectCard(p);
  });
  container.innerHTML = html;
}

// --- Tab Switching ---
function switchProjTab(tabId) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".proj-tab-content").forEach(function(el) { el.style.display = "none"; });
  document.querySelectorAll(".proj-tab").forEach(function(btn) { btn.style.color = "#999"; btn.style.borderBottomColor = "transparent"; });
  document.getElementById("tab-" + tabId).style.display = "block";
  var activeBtn = document.querySelector(".proj-tab[data-tab=\'" + tabId + "\']");
  if (activeBtn) { activeBtn.style.color = "var(--epi-navy)"; activeBtn.style.borderBottomColor = "var(--epi-navy)"; }
}

// --- Recommended Projects Rendering ---
function makeRecCard(r) {
  var isYes = r.recommend_project === "Yes";
  var statusColor = isYes ? "#28a745" : "#ffc107";
  var borderColor = statusColor;
  var slug = r.school_name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/-$/, "");

  var html = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.25rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1rem; border-left:4px solid \' + borderColor + \';">\';

  // Header: school name + date
  html += \'<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.5rem;">\';
  html += \'<a href="schools.html?school=\' + slug + \'" style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-weight:700; font-size:1.05rem; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--epi-navy);">\' + r.school_name + \'</a>\';
  var dateStr = r.update_date || "";
  if (dateStr) { var d = new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00"); dateStr = d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric"}); }
  html += \'<span style="color:#999; font-size:0.8rem; white-space:nowrap;">\' + dateStr + \'</span>\';
  html += \'</div>\';

  // Recommendation: show specific project types as badges, or "Unspecified" in grey if none
  var hasTypes = r.recommended_types && String(r.recommended_types).trim() !== "";
  html += \'<div style="margin:0 0 0.35rem; font-size:0.9rem; display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.35rem;">\';
  html += \'<strong>Recommendation:</strong>\';
  if (hasTypes) {
    var types = String(r.recommended_types).split(",");
    types.forEach(function(t) {
      var trimmed = t.trim();
      if (trimmed) html += \' <span style="display:inline-block; background:#e8f5e9; color:#2e7d32; border:1px solid #a5d6a7; padding:0.15rem 0.6rem; border-radius:12px; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600;">\' + trimmed + \'</span>\';
    });
  } else {
    html += \' <span style="color:#6c757d; font-weight:600;">Unspecified</span>\';
  }
  html += \'</div>\';

  // MGR swap — only show the badge when a swap is actually recommended
  if (r.recommend_mgr_swap === "Yes") {
    html += \'<p style="margin:0.35rem 0 0; font-size:0.85rem;"><span style="display:inline-block; background:#fff3cd; color:#856404; border:1px solid #ffc107; padding:0.15rem 0.6rem; border-radius:12px; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600;">MGR Swap: Yes</span></p>\';
  }

  // Visitor
  if (r.visitor) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.8rem; margin:0.35rem 0 0; color:#aaa;">Reported by \' + r.visitor + \'</p>\';
  }

  html += \'</div>\';
  return html;
}

function renderRecommended() {
  var filter = document.getElementById("rec-filter").value;
  var startDate = document.getElementById("rec-date-start").value;
  var endDate = document.getElementById("rec-date-end").value;
  var container = document.getElementById("recommended-container");

  var filtered = ALL_RECOMMENDED.filter(function(r) {
    // Date range filter
    if (startDate && r.update_date && r.update_date < startDate) return false;
    if (endDate && r.update_date && r.update_date > endDate) return false;
    // Status filter
    if (!filter) return true;
    if (filter === "Yes") return r.recommend_project === "Yes";
    if (filter === "Maybe") return r.recommend_project && (r.recommend_project.indexOf("Maybe") >= 0);
    if (filter === "mgr-swap") return r.recommend_mgr_swap === "Yes";
    return true;
  });

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#999; font-style:italic; margin:0;">No recommendations match this filter.</p></div>\';
    return;
  }

  // Sort: most recent update_date first, then alphabetically by school name as a tiebreaker
  filtered.sort(function(a, b) {
    var da = a.update_date || "";
    var db = b.update_date || "";
    if (da !== db) return db.localeCompare(da);
    return (a.school_name || "").localeCompare(b.school_name || "");
  });

  var html = "";
  filtered.forEach(function(r) { html += makeRecCard(r); });
  container.innerHTML = html;
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  // Tab click listeners
  document.querySelectorAll(".proj-tab").forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function() { switchProjTab(this.getAttribute("data-tab")); });
  });

  // Update recommended count badge
  var yesCount = ALL_RECOMMENDED.filter(function(r) { return r.recommend_project === "Yes"; }).length;
  document.getElementById("tab-count-rec").textContent = yesCount;

  // Completed projects tab
  populateTypeFilter();
  renderProjects();
  document.getElementById("btn-apply-dates").addEventListener("click", renderProjects);
  document.getElementById("type-filter").addEventListener("change", renderProjects);
  document.getElementById("btn-reset-dates").addEventListener("click", function() {
    var now = new Date();
    var syYear = now.getMonth() >= 7 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1;
    document.getElementById("date-start").value = syYear + "-08-01";
    document.getElementById("date-end").value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    document.getElementById("type-filter").value = "";
    renderProjects();
  });

  // Recommended projects tab
  renderRecommended();
  document.getElementById("rec-filter").addEventListener("change", renderRecommended);
  document.getElementById("btn-apply-rec").addEventListener("click", renderRecommended);
  document.getElementById("btn-reset-rec").addEventListener("click", function() {
    var now = new Date();
    var syYear = now.getMonth() >= 7 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1;
    document.getElementById("rec-date-start").value = syYear + "-08-01";
    document.getElementById("rec-date-end").value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    document.getElementById("rec-filter").value = "";
    renderRecommended();
  });

  // Check URL params for tab
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var tabParam = params.get("tab");
  if (tabParam === "recommended") switchProjTab("recommended");
  else switchProjTab("completed");
});
</script>
'))
```
